info.title: 4TechLead Integrations API
info.description: API documentation for registering external systems, mapping people to external identifiers, receiving webhook events, and reading delivery metrics used by 4TechLead.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Create and manage Laravel Sanctum tokens used by the protected API endpoints.

tags.name: Integration systems
tags.description: Authenticated management of systems that send webhook events.

tags.name: External identities
tags.description: Authenticated mapping between a person and a system-generated external actor code.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Public ingestion endpoint called by GitHub, ClickUp, or custom automations.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Authenticated notification feed generated by external notification webhooks.

tags.name: Delivery metrics
tags.description: Authenticated read-only metrics generated from webhook events.

post.summary: Generate an external actor code for a person
post.description: Creates one mapping for a person in an integration system and generates `external_code`. Use the returned value as `external_actor_code` in webhook payloads. A person can have only one active code per integration system.
